assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the three reviewed items curated on tokyo-7th-sisters:asami-miwako@game at basis_commit: #b0222-deep-reading, the canonical T7S_B0222 reading of the complete Sub Intimacy family 200720 (seven short addresses, episodes 401000313, 401000436, 401000758, 401001054, 401001142, 401001314, 401001430), read in full; #b0232-deep-reading, the Miwako section (case 39, Short message 402004201, P0-P2) of the canonical T7S_B0232 reading, read with its entering boundary, identity/audience/time, synthesis and exit sections; and #b0239-deep-reading, the Miwako case (Birthday portfolio 404000041, family 201270, P0-P30) of the canonical T7S_B0239 reading, read with its scope, whole-unit synthesis, question adjudication, rival models and the case's voice and inline-dependency rows. All are in the Japanese offline game witness T7S_GAME_OFFLINE_JA_R484 (c20260909-r484), as the readings report it. The other 41 B0232 cases and 8 B0239 cases are context only, as are the earlier Miwako readings B0094, B0120, B0132, B0139, B0160, B0170, B0177 and B0180 that B0222 and B0239 compare against; none of them is curated on this subject and nothing is borrowed from them. No performed voice, music, movie or runtime was reviewed by any reading, and the evaluator performed no primary-source inspection.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: Nine conditional occurrences (seven Intimacy addresses, one Short message and one Birthday portfolio) with no inferred unlock level, calendar year or chronology among them: B0222's A-G key asserts no total order, B0232's catalog order fixes no shared date or placement relative to Main, and B0239 gives no common year, numerical age or Main placement for its portfolios. The 2月5日 lettering on the B0239 stand is source artwork, not a dated state. B0239 positions her as an adult without an age, and her B0222 C:P2 reference to being younger fixes none. No state before, after or between these occurrences is assessed.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit; evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: One pattern recurs across three dedicated readings and is tested against rivals in two of them: Miwako welcomes recognition of particulars while resisting reduction to it. In B0222 a noticed hobby becomes a mystery she challenges the manager to solve (A:P1-P3), concert details stay secret (B:P5) and a food dislike is to stay private (F:P5). In B0239 she enjoys adult drinking and childlike delight in gifts at once (P2-6) yet asks whether others see her too thoroughly as an alcohol character (P7-8), and receives as recognition of her own teaching the stand and board that her pupils made (P17-29). B0232 P1-P2 makes the members' effort a standard for herself. B0239 rejects generic-birthday, total-care-cure, total-cynicism and alcohol-only rivals, and B0222 rejects reading A as a romantic confession. Rejected C: there is no trigger, state guard or tested conditional rule, and the earlier readings both use as counterevidence are not enrolled. Rejected E: three gated readings converging on one pattern, with rival tests, exceed a single located trait.

None of the readings orders its occurrences, and B0239 supplies no year or age. Her 'recent tearfulness' self-description (B0239 P25-27) and her remark that she was not always like this when younger (B0222 C:P2) are situated self-accounts, not tracked states. The earlier readings that would locate development (B0094, B0170, B0180) are not enrolled.

Located wording is limited to titles such as 秘密事項, 内緒にしてよ？ and How’s it going？, the self-correction from ちょっと to 結構ダイタン (B0222 B:P4), the address ファーブちゃん, the written greeting ズドラーストヴィチェ (G:P1), the written English Dear, Mister (B0232 P0) and the address 支配人くん (B0239 P9, P26); other turns are paraphrased. B0222's 30 voice references and B0239's 15 mapped WAVs are unheard, and B0232 states that its English is written presentation. Rejected D: no register analysis is in evidence.

Ordinary acts are located: a reported music conversation and live-show invitation (B0222 B), leaving restaurant choice to the manager while excluding mentaiko (F:P2-P4), imagined study abroad (E), a language exchange with Tasha (G:P2), writing a paper and helping members study (B0232 P0-P1), and repeated toasts at her party with a request for company in the next one (B0239 P2-6, P28-29). Each is a single case, and the meal, outing, trip, tutoring and later consumption are reported, proposed or unshown.

The manager is addressed throughout and has no reply of his own; in B0239 his further-present announcement reaches the reader only through her uptake. Ferb, Tasha, the classmate, the friend and the members are reported through Miwako. B0239 adds nine attributed written board messages (Mimi, Manon, ChaCha, Shirayuki, Matsuri, Sisara, Tasha, Shinju, Murasaki) and a collective みんな, but the reading states the writers have no spoken turns and she answers no one individually. Rejected D: differentiated appraisals of her are not her conduct toward differentiated counterparts.

Interior states are spoken: pleasure at being noticed (B0222 A:P1), hesitation about concert conduct (B:P3-P4), frustration then relief (D:P4-P5), pronunciation uncertainty (G:P4), work that is hard yet enjoyable (B0232 P0), and in B0239 felt return to childhood (P4-6), self-questioning about the alcohol image (P7-8), and tears, thanks and gladness to spend the day at Nanasta (P25-27). B0239 states no medical cause or intoxication is observed. Each is local to one occurrence.

One located episode, reported rather than shown: she answers a classmate's implied dismissal of idols, in retelling, by insisting something good is good, then apologizes to the manager and thanks him for listening (B0222 D:P1-P5). The classmate has no turn. B0232 and B0239 add no conflict; the alcohol-image question is a self-question, not a dispute.

No reading analyzes ethical reasoning by Miwako. B0239's minors-juice line (P28-29) is a practical distinction that the reading declines to read as a hosting policy, and ChaCha's moderation caution is another writer's; neither is analyzed deliberation. Absence is not evidence about her ethics.

Play is located in the mystery challenge (B0222 A:P2-P3), the mock-official refusal of concert details (B:P5), the suggestive remark she then calls a joke while teasing the manager's blush (F:P1-P2), and in B0239 an uncounted repeated toast (P2) and a company demand that the reading calls playful pressure (P28). Instances are single and short.

Each unit is complete: the seven-occurrence Intimacy family, the three-page message and the 31-page Birthday portfolio with its native objects and backgrounds. Together they are nine occurrences, the earlier readings are not enrolled, and no performance was heard.

Affirmative local limits are located: no ready formula on becoming sexy (B0222 C:P2), a mentaiko and spice dislike (F:P3-P4), unresolved pronunciation (G:P4), withheld concert details (B:P5), combined work called unexpectedly hard (B0232 P0), and her explicit statement that minors get juice (B0239 P28-29), which the reading uses to defeat an everyone-drinks reading. Rejected D: each limit is local to one occurrence.
No chronology, year, unlock level or placement relative to Main orders the nine occurrences; adult status is given without an age, and the stand's date is artwork.

scenario_readiness.note: With mostly paraphrased speech, unheard voice references, written-only English and Russian greetings and no register analysis, generated lines would be fluent invention rather than source-supported voice. This bounds the evidence set, not Miwako's speech.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: Any of the nine unordered occurrences; nothing before, after or between them.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: The manager as addressed listener without a reply of his own, or Nanasta collectively as a party audience; the refusal applies equally to Ferb, Tasha, the board writers, classmates or any other counterpart, none of whom has a turn in the evidence.
setting_constraints: Crossover, counterfactual or materially novel contexts beyond the nine located occurrences
Behavioral or dialogue simulation rather than bounded canon description

scenario_readiness.note: Nine short unordered occurrences addressed to a silent manager or a collective audience, with no conditional rules, cannot support a novel context.

A restaurant condition, music companionship, study plans, a language exchange, reported tutoring and one birthday party with a minors-juice distinction answer bounded canon questions about these occurrences but give no procedure for an unfamiliar ordinary situation.
No ethical deliberation by Miwako is analyzed in any reading.

B0222 F supports a flirtatious remark she calls a joke and her teasing of the manager's blush, but the reading states no after-meeting intimacy or reciprocal romance is completed and A's mystery is not a romantic confession. B0239 states that no romantic agreement or full reply from the manager is provided. Simulating a romantic relationship would exceed the evidence.

B0222 C shows a request she cannot answer, D a defense of idol work in retelling and E a wish to keep working; B0232 reports tutoring and an offer of help with no session or consultation shown; B0239's board praises her teaching, but those are others' written appraisals and the stand is a gift, not a performed task. No professional task is performed and no rule generalizes her working conduct.

known_limits.statement: The nine sources are conditional occurrences with no chronology, unlock level, year or placement relative to Main; B0222's A-G key and the B0232 and B0239 catalog orders are execution orders, and cross-case comparisons are formal.

Ferb, Tasha, the members, the classmate and the friend are reported through Miwako with no turns, the manager has no reply of his own, and the nine B0239 board messages are written appraisals with no spoken turns; the classmate's dismissal is her interpretation and her praise of the members is her appraisal.

The live-show outing, the meal and after-meeting time, study in Britain and its funding, the overseas tour, future adult gatherings when the members grow up, and the board's QOP invitation and joint-singing offers are proposed or imagined, not shown; Ferb's assent, the manager's promise of privacy and everyone's assent to further company are absent.

The paper, the tutoring and the offer of help are reported in one message: B0232 establishes no paper subject, degree, publication or assessment, no individual pupils, grades or session, and no consultation the manager accepts. B0239's board praise is not an established result.

B0239 positions Miwako as an adult and marks drinking as an adult pleasure, but supplies no numerical age, birthday year, intoxication, subsequent consumption or underage drinking; minors are expressly given juice.
Her own question whether she is seen too much as an alcohol character, and the stand's teaching, music and gratitude, are the reading's grounds for rejecting an alcohol-only or universal-drunk model.

No voice reference, music or movie was heard or viewed in any reading, and the pronunciation of the Russian and English greetings cannot be adjudicated from their written form; B0239's tears rest on written text and static face states, with no acoustic sob observed.

The earlier Miwako readings (B0094, B0120, B0132, B0139, B0160, B0170, B0177, B0180) are not curated on this subject, so the comparisons with her teaching, coaching, festival care, embraces, plural futures and the teacher-container fear were not checked. Missing support is not evidence that those states are absent.
Beyond titles and a few quoted words, the readings paraphrase Miwako's Japanese, so self-reference, sentence endings and register are not in the curated evidence.
